script_content = '''import json
import sys

TOOLS = "/workspace/skills/toolsandbox-assistant/tools.py"
friends = ["Maya Bennett", "Jordan Kim", "Sofia Ramirez", "Elena Ramirez"]

import subprocess

all_results = {}
for name in friends:
    cmd = [sys.executable, TOOLS, "search_contacts", "--json", json.dumps({"name": name, "relationship": "friend"})]
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    output_line = proc.stdout.strip().split("\\n")[-1]
    parsed = json.loads(output_line)
    all_results[name] = parsed

# Build markdown lines without any bold markers
lines = []
lines.append("# Friends Contact Lookup")
lines.append("")

for name, result in all_results.items():
    lines.append("## " + name)
    if result.get("ok") and result.get("result"):
        for contact in result["result"]:
            pid = str(contact.get("person_id", "N/A"))
            cname = str(contact.get("name", "N/A"))
            phone = str(contact.get("phone_number", "N/A"))
            rel = str(contact.get("relationship", "N/A"))
            lines.append("- Person ID: " + pid)
            lines.append("- Name: " + cname)
            lines.append("- Phone: " + phone)
            lines.append("- Relationship: " + rel)
    elif result.get("ok"):
        lines.append("- No matching contact found.")
    else:
        err = result.get("error", {})
        lines.append("- Error: " + str(err.get("type", "Unknown")) + " - " + str(err.get("message", "")))
    lines.append("")

lines.append("## Raw JSON Data")
lines.append("")
lines.append(json.dumps(all_results, indent=2))

report = "\\n".join(lines)

import os
os.makedirs("/workspace/output", exist_ok=True)
with open("/workspace/output/friends_contacts.md", "w") as f:
    f.write(report)

print("FILE_WRITTEN")
print(json.dumps(all_results, indent=2))
'''
write_res = await write_file("./search_friends.py", script_content)
print(write_res)

run_res = await run_command("python ./search_friends.py")
print(run_res)

file_content = await read_file("./output/friends_contacts.md")
